about: Fadal VMC 4020, self-made in Blender (sources/fadal/build_fadal.py) from dealer photos (white enclosure, the red vertical 'Fadal' script on the left panel, blue foot bands lettered 'VMC 4020', two sliding doors with large windows over a stainless apron and sill, the CNC 88HS pendant built into the right panel with its CRT, keyboard, e-stop, buttons, override knobs and handwheel, 'COOL POWER' lettering) and the record's specs: the head (white, 'Fadal') with the spindle motor standing through the roof, the column, Z bellows and counterbalance behind it, the 21-tool carousel at the left under the roof, the 48 x 20 in table with three T-slots on its saddle, telescopic way covers, a blue vise holding a part, a CAT40 holder and end mill in the spindle, coolant hoses, the coolant tank and pump behind on the left and the electrical cabinet behind on the right. Doors closed: the work zone shows through the glass.
reviewed: 2026-11-05: modelled against dealer photos; look sheets and three.js before/after checked
